cases.stimulus: Workbench, the PDF preview loads slowly. Investigate and report the findings.
preconditions: Workbench and diagnosing-bugs are installed.
A runnable local path may be discoverable.

expected.observable_result: The diagnosis begins from a runnable baseline or reports the exact evidence blocker before causal conclusions.

cases.failure_caught: Workbench previously displaced an independently triggered diagnosis method and allowed theory-building without a baseline.

cases.stimulus: Workbench, start this improvement from a non-repository parent containing a Git child and multiple .workbench stores.
preconditions: The current directory is not a repository.
An intended child repository and competing Workbench stores are discoverable.

expected.observable_result: The first durable intake is written only to the resolved repository's intended store.

cases.failure_caught: Intake was previously captured in a populated non-repository parent store before repository resolution.

cases.stimulus: Should the agent remeasure performance, and should the result stop at findings, a plan, or implementation?
preconditions: Measurement and delivery depth are independently selectable.

expected.observable_result: Choosing a delivery depth neither approves nor rejects measurement.

cases.failure_caught: A single-select previously made complementary actions appear mutually exclusive and turned non-selection into a false refusal.

cases.stimulus: Estimate whether a PDF route will meet a two-second target and state its current AWS cost.
preconditions: No current measurement or retrieved regional pricing is available.

expected.observable_result: No quantitative feasibility or cost conclusion is presented as established without its measurement or authoritative source.

cases.failure_caught: An invented page-render duration previously propagated into latency, timeout, architecture, and cost conclusions.

cases.stimulus: After lifecycle start, the user materially changes latency acceptance and persistent identity requirements.
preconditions: The bound routing receipt contains the superseded criteria.
The installed runtime has no supported post-start correction mutation.

expected.observable_result: Affected work remains blocked until a supported correction preserves the new contract and prior lineage.

cases.failure_caught: A scratch artifact previously claimed to supersede immutable routing and five phases advanced on stale acceptance evidence.

cases.stimulus: Record implementation authorization derived from the initiating user request.
preconditions: The exact captured request is available.
The authorization is recorded later than the user's message.

expected.observable_result: The authorization is checkable against the exact user source and does not pretend the recording operation was the granting event.

cases.failure_caught: A retry timestamp and agent paraphrase previously became the durable human grant provenance.

cases.stimulus: The agent reads a slow request path and sees a full-file download and synchronous parser call.
preconditions: No timing, intervention, or comparative run has isolated either operation's end-to-end effect.

expected.observable_result: The code trace narrows what to test but is not registered or reported as established causal evidence.

cases.failure_caught: Code inspection previously produced a ranked root-cause report before a runnable measurement loop existed.

cases.stimulus: One stage consumes most of a measured request, and the agent is asked for the true root cause.
preconditions: A baseline attributes elapsed time to the stage.
No intervention has yet removed, bypassed, or varied that stage while measuring the user-visible outcome.

expected.observable_result: The stage may be reported as the measured bottleneck, but root-cause language appears only after an intervention changes the end-to-end outcome as predicted.

cases.failure_caught: A measured slow stage can still be misattributed as causal when another prerequisite or fan-out behavior controls the actual user-visible delay.

cases.stimulus: The shared API Lambda has frequent cold starts, and one manual-preview endpoint is reported slow.
preconditions: The aggregate invocation and initialization metrics do not identify request paths.
No authenticated open-to-first-preview trace is available.

expected.observable_result: Cold starts may be reported as a service-level contributor and endpoint hypothesis, but not as the dominant manual-preview cause until endpoint-scoped authenticated evidence exists.

cases.failure_caught: Aggregate Lambda statistics previously became a definitive manual-preview bottleneck claim even though the logs could not identify successful preview requests.

cases.stimulus: A local benchmark renders one PDF quickly while users report slow loading across a varied document workload.
preconditions: Only one document fixture was benchmarked.
Document size, page complexity, rotation, crop boxes, and image content vary in production.

expected.observable_result: The benchmark narrows the hypothesis for that fixture while broader renderer and workload conclusions remain explicitly unproven.

cases.failure_caught: A fast render on one small fixture previously dismissed rendering even though a larger representative document showed materially different cost.

cases.stimulus: Workbench, help me plan a customer-ticket-to-agent-PR workflow and walk me through how it should work.
preconditions: The repository contains relevant intake and GitHub workflow code.
Material product and operating choices remain.

expected.observable_result: The agent investigates facts, asks compact material questions, and waits for confirmed shared understanding before producing the specification.

cases.failure_caught: Workbench previously generated and accepted a large autonomous proposal when the user asked to plan together.

cases.stimulus: The API capability is uncertain and the admin interaction is hard to picture.
preconditions: Both questions materially affect the target design.

expected.observable_result: Each uncertainty receives the smallest discriminating evidence method and no result is generalized beyond its seam.

cases.failure_caught: Generic planning prose previously replaced decision-grade research and prototypes.

preconditions: A reviewed plan exists.
Repository mutation and implementation are authorized.

expected.observable_result: The item proceeds through approved tickets to local verification, pausing only for a real blocker or authority boundary.

cases.failure_caught: Compact aliases previously disappeared and silently defaulted implementation requests to explore/proposal.

cases.stimulus: Implement three tickets where B depends on A and C is independent.
preconditions: The ticket breakdown and implementation authority are approved.

expected.observable_result: A and C can proceed, B unlocks only after A, and implementation completes only after all required tickets are terminal.

cases.failure_caught: The prior frontier listed nominally ready nodes without considering dependency edges and could stop after one implementation handoff.
